from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InterestExpenseRecord(BaseModel):
    """Interest expense reported in one company's financial filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name the filing belongs to")
    interest_expense: float | None = Field(description="The interest expense amount as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period the interest expense figure covers")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim line or section containing the interest expense figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    interest_expense_records: list[InterestExpenseRecord]
